```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(forcats)
```

```{r}
nhanes <- read_csv("examples/nhanes-equity/data/nhanes_equity_v6.csv", 
                    show_col_types = FALSE)
head(nhanes)
colnames(nhanes)
```

```{r}
nhanes |> ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = Weight, colour = Gender)) +
geom_point(alpha = .2) +
labs(x = "Age (years)",
     y = "Weight (kg)",
     title = "Relationship between Weight vs. Age",
     subtitle = "One point per record, unweighted descriptive only") +
     theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
nhanes |> ggplot(aes(x = Age, y = BMI, colour = Gender)) +
geom_point(alpha = .2) +
facet_wrap(~IncomeGroup) + 
labs(x = "Age (years)",
     y = "Weight (kg)",
     title = "Relationship between Weight vs. Age",
     subtitle = "One point per record, unweighted descriptive only") +
# stat_summary(fun = mean)
     theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
nhanes |> 
filter(IncomeGroup != "NA") |>
mutate(IncomeGroup = fct_relevel(IncomeGroup, 
"Low Income (<1.3)",
"Middle Income",
"High Income (>3.5)"
)) |>
ggplot(aes(fill = Gender, x = IncomeGroup)) +
geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
labs(title = "Population Count in Each Income Group between Two Sexes",
subtitle = "Unweighted counts",
x = "Record Count",
y = "Income Groups") +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```
